svg.title: Hybrid RAG & int8 vector search in Cloudflare D1 + NotebookDO / Hybrid RAG & int8-Vektorsuche in Cloudflare D1 + NotebookDO
svg.desc: Five-stage pipeline: 1. browser chunking, 2. 768d embeddings and symmetric int8 quantization, 3. storage in D1 + FTS5 index, 4. hybrid search via NotebookDO in-memory dot product and D1 FTS5 BM25 with Reciprocal Rank Fusion, 5. citation-validated SSE chat. / Fünfstufige Pipeline: 1. Browser-Chunking, 2. 768d Embeddings und symmetrische int8-Quantisierung, 3. Speicherung in D1 + FTS5-Index, 4. Hybrid-Suche via NotebookDO In-Memory Dot-Product und D1 FTS5 BM25 mit Reciprocal Rank Fusion, 5. Zitat-validierter SSE-Chat.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

switch.text: Hybrid-RAG-Pipeline: 768d int8-Quantisierung + D1 FTS5 BM25 + Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF)
